name: Google Cloud IAM
description: The Sumo Logic App for Google Cloud IAM gives you visibility into the activities in your Cloud IAM. The preconfigured dashboards allow you to monitor the IAM project activities, operations, role activities, and policy changes.

children.name: Google Cloud IAM - Overview
children.description: See the overview of your Google Cloud IAM including the operations, project, IAM role, and service account activities.

panels.name: Messages by Project
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/GCP/cloudaudit logName resource timestamp
| json "message.data.resource.type" as type 
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\"" 
| where type = "iam_role" or type = "project" or type = "service_account"
| where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Factivity"
| json "message.data.resource.labels" as labels
| json field=labels "project_id" as project

| timeslice 1h
| count as messages by _timeslice, project
| transpose row _timeslice column project

panels.name: Recent Project Activity
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/GCP/cloudaudit logName resource timestamp
| json "message.data" as data
| json field=data "resource.type" as type 
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\"" 
| where type = "project" 
| where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Factivity"
| json field=data "resource.labels", "timestamp", "resource.labels.project_id", "protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail", "protoPayload.serviceData.policyDelta.bindingDeltas[*]" as labels, timestamp, project, user, changes

| parse regex field=changes "\"role\":\"roles\\\/(?<role>[a-zA-Z.]+)\",\"member\":\"(?<member>.*?)\",\"action\":\"(?<action>[A-Z]+)\"" multi
| count by action, role, member, timestamp, user
| fields timestamp, user, action, role, member
| sort by timestamp

panels.name: Recent IAM Role Activity

| json field=payload "authenticationInfo.principalEmail", "response.title" as user, name
| parse regex "\"methodName\":\"[^\"]+\.(?<method>[^\"]+)\""

| count by user, method, name, timestamp, project
| fields timestamp, user, method, project, name
| sort by timestamp

children.name: Google Cloud IAM - Role Activity
children.description: See the details of IAM policy changes, user operations, role assignments, and role additions and removal.

panels.name: IAM Policy Changes by Project
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/GCP/cloudaudit logName resource timestamp
| json "message.data.resource.type" as type 
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\"" 
| where type = "project" | where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Factivity"
| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.protoPayload.methodName" as labels, method
| where method = "SetIamPolicy"
| json "message.data.resource.labels.project_id" as project

| timeslice 1h
| count as changes by _timeslice, project
| transpose row _timeslice column project

_sourceCategory = Labs/GCP/cloudaudit logName resource timestamp

| sort by timestamp asc
| 1 as operation
| accum operation as total_operations by user
| fields timestamp, user, action, role, member, total_operations
